_note: Transcribed from the printed Atelier reference cards. Click counts, concentrations, frequency and route are taken verbatim. ASSUMPTIONS FLAGGED FOR REVIEW: (1) startDate is a placeholder; (2) Glow Blend phase lengths are not stated on the card — 14/14/ongoing assumed; (3) '5 days on / 2 days off' is applied as a rolling cycle from the start date, not fixed weekdays.

protocol.name: Jessica's Protocol
injectionSteps: Press the plunger all the way down and hold for 10 seconds

pens.name: Tesa / Ipa Combo
pens.advisory: Dosed to Tesamorelin only. At these dial settings this pen's fixed 4:1 ratio delivers roughly 25% of the Ipamorelin the reference card calls for. Do not turn the dial higher to compensate — that would overdose Tesamorelin. If the full Ipamorelin dose is needed, it comes from a separate source.
